== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill when at least two allied minions are below 50% health.

== Notes ==
* Where [[Verata's Sacrifice]] works on your own minions, Blood of the Master heals all allied minions, including those in separate [[Party|parties]]. Be careful when using this skill if there is another [[minion master]] around.
* A minion master [[spam]]ming this skill can often keep their minions alive for periods far exceeding their usual life span; however, such a player can be a large drain on their party's [[healer]].
* If your party has multiple minion masters, heroes will kill themselves with this skill if not having access to strong self-healing. To counteract this, consider bringing {{skill icon|Taste of Death}} on that hero, since this makes them much less likely to die. 
* It is even possible to kill yourself at full health by using this skill; with at least 48 minions, you will sacrifice 101% health.
